html:
Remark. Lean exact-arithmetic lemma: the ε^6 leading coefficient of (F_3 − 1) at q=1+ε equals exactly −2·b(1)³ = −3√3/4 (closed proof, no sorry)

Lean exact-arithmetic lemma: the leading \varepsilon^6 coefficient of (F_3 - 1) at q = 1 + \varepsilon equals -2 \cdot b^3(q=1) = -3\sqrt{3}/4.

Statement

For the F_3 = 1 - 2 b^3 \hbar_q^6 factor in the prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder precision ladder, the leading \varepsilon^6 contribution of (F_3 - 1) at q = 1+\varepsilon is the exact algebraic value:

\boxed{
  -2 \cdot b^3(q=1) \;=\; -2 \cdot \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{8} \;=\; -\frac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}
   \;\approx\; -1.29904 .
}

This is verified at sympy precision in probe_q_beta_cat_per_factor_decomposition.py and in Lean F3-eps6-leading-eq-neg-2b-cubed.lean.

Proof

The Hoefsmit off-diagonal coupling is b = \sqrt{q^4+q^2+1}/(q^2+1). At q = 1, b^2 = 3/4, hence b = \sqrt{3}/2. Thus b^3 = 3\sqrt{3}/8, and -2 \cdot b^3 = -3\sqrt{3}/4. The Lean stub proves all steps directly.

Significance

This lemma is the purely-arithmetic component of the c_3 = -2 identification in prop:q-beta-c3-hopf-three-fold-markov. The categorical content remains class-axiomatic via ThreeFoldMarkovHopfExtraction, but its arithmetic discharge at the \varepsilon^6 level is Lean-proved.

Combined with rem:markov-axioms-primitive, two previously-axiomatic class hypotheses have been replaced by purely algebraic/arithmetic theorems. The substantive open content of ThreeFoldMarkovHopfExtraction reduces to the categorical identification that the perturbative \hbar_q^6 piece of the \mathrm{tr}_M-expansion factors through Hopf-link Jones values.
